12 (Nil Zone) |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]20,000 |shield_hp = [[File:ShieldHealth.png|20px|Shield Health]]55,000 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Slow (1.75) |defense = {{Defense}}25% |cash = {{Money|1,000}} every 1% health |spawned_by = [[Mechanical Rot (Nil Zone)|Mechanical Rot]] |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = {{BossList|Ref = Only the first '''Executioner''' is a [[Boss]] enemy.|Default}} |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Head Chopping}}''' - The '''Executioner''' throws its axe at a random tower, stunning any tower hit by it. }} ==Description== The '''Executioner''', internally referred to as '''Executioner Plush''', is a boss in [[Pizza Party]], debuting on Wave 35. It has an extremely high amount of health and walks at a slow speed. The '''Executioner''' has one ability where it throws its axe at a random tower, stunning any tower hit by it. ==Appearance== The '''Executioner''' is a plushie version of the Level 5 {{Color|Eclipse|Eclipse}} [[Executioner]]. It has a dark purple helmet with horns with blue glow inside of it, dark purple shoulder-pads, chestplate and leg padding. It has yellow button kneepads, a purple belt and a giant yellow button on its torso. It also wears purple gloves and shoes. The '''Executioner''' wields a large grey and red axe which it uses to attack towers. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, such as the [[Pursuit]], [[Ranger]], [[Engineer]] and [[Turret]] are recommended to take this enemy down. **The [[DJ Booth]] and [[Commander]] can be used to boost these towers. *The [[Medic]] can be used to shield towers, preventing them from being stunned by the '''Executioner's''' ''Head Chopping'' ability. **Alternatively, you can place cheap towers along the path to divert the ability away from your main damage towers. **You can also use towers that are immune to stuns, such as the [[Ranger]] and [[Pursuit]]. *When it first spawns, it is a boss enemy, limiting the amount of towers that can slow it down. **Confusion, Slowness, and poison effects cannot slow it down at all, so using towers with these effects to stall it is not advised on its debut wave. **Freezing towers cannot freeze it, but can still slow it down through chill. *Cheap towers can be placed on the side of the map to bait the '''Executioner''', making it target insignificant towers instead of your main DPS towers. **It can also be used to stall the '''Executioner'''. While performing its ability, it will stop moving, giving you more time to kill it. This, however, requires towers to be in range, which makes it pretty useful to have a cheap distraction tower near it at all times. Regardless, this is not mandatory. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Abilities |- |[[File:ExecutionerSwing.ogg]] |When the '''Executioner''' performs ''Head Chopping'' ability |- |[[File:AxeHit.ogg]] |When the '''Executioner''' performs ''Head Chopping'' ability |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} ExecutionerWalk.gif|Walking animation (22 January 2025 – Present) ExecutionerThrow.gif|''Head Chopping'' animation (22 January 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1Exe.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseExe.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, walk animation (12 March 2025 – Present) CorpseExecutionerDeath.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, death animation (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ExecutionerPlushIconIG.png|'''Executioner''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Update History== *'''22 January 2025''' -
